title: Chimichurri Sauce Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 tbsp of oregano, fresh, finely chopped
1 tbsp of hot pepper sauce, optional
100ml of sherry vinegar, or red wine vinegar
ldInstructionsRaw: To make the chimmichurri sauce, combine all of the ingredients (apart from the olive oil) in a bowl and mix thoroughly to combine
Vigorously stir in the olive oil to emulsify, then transfer to a jar or bowl to serve
